easylist (base filter-list pack)
================================

Vendored assets: the two pinned rule-set snapshots in `../snapshots/`. Unlike
                 the flag-icons recipe, the upstream bytes ARE committed:
                 easylist.to serves only the current list and expires it in
                 days, so the tree is the only durable pin. The pack built
                 from them is published to the delivery plane and is not
                 committed.
Owners:          The EasyList authors (https://easylist.to); TaffyGo decides
                 which lists ship and how they are packaged (decision 0076,
                 which also resolves OD-070)
Licence:         GPL-3.0, elected from the GPL-3.0 / CC BY-SA 3.0 dual offer
                 the EasyList authors make
                 (https://easylist.to/pages/licence.html). The text is
                 vendor/easylist.GPL3.txt, next to this file, and travels
                 verbatim as the pack's own LICENSE member so a device that
                 has the rules has the terms beside them. The lists are data
                 the browser reads, never code it links.
Source:          https://easylist.to/easylist/easylist.txt and
                 https://easylist.to/easylist/easyprivacy.txt
Downloaded:      2026-08-27 (UTC), the versions and digests below

sha256_easylist_202608272347_txt=1ae4280769e07779d4686fae9b562cafc55f3cf0f787d76ae9da2c719360dabf
bytes_easylist_202608272347_txt=2095505
sha256_easyprivacy_202608272349_txt=9f101ef2046f6cacbf2a3156c0562d7318a1ac1d9ced194db7a04fb419b22a66
bytes_easyprivacy_202608272349_txt=1498992
version_easylist=202608272347
version_easyprivacy=202608272349
pack_sha256=c1ea235b7eb1de2efa7b6fd6f5af802fa548e779b9e008efe98ff629a16eef10
pack_bytes=1183665

The pack is one zip of three members — lists/easylist.txt,
lists/easyprivacy.txt and LICENSE — built by `../tools/build_filter_pack.py`,
which refuses to package bytes whose digests differ from the pins in
`../tools/manifest.json` and rebuilds byte-identically (its `--self-test`
proves both). The pack digest above is what this builder reproduced; the
catalog row stays unpublished until `./tools/assets publish` has uploaded the
pack and verified the origin serves exactly these bytes back.

Permitted use:   the compiled rule sets behind ad and tracker blocking
                 (CAP-BR-022), loaded by `filtering.browser` from the asset
                 store and matched by `filtering.core`. The lists never enter
                 the AI data plane and never leave the device.

Removal trigger: these snapshots leave the tree when a newer pair replaces
                 them under a new revision, when decision 0076 is superseded,
                 or the moment the upstream licence offer changes.
